address_kind: PE virtual addresses; field offsets and sizes in bytes
classification: Three complete local static bodies: one list unlink contract and two narrow forwarding mechanics; no execution validation or complete lifetime contract

contracts.abi: ECX=N; no stack arguments consumed; RET; no EDX input read; EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI untouched locally
contracts.mechanics: Read32(N), push that value, call00944c94, pop into ECX, RET; normal EAX forwarded from callee without a declared semantic result
contracts.boundary: 00944c94 forwards its stack argument to009452ca; neither wrapper establishes allocator compatibility, nested ownership, pointer validity or null safety
limits: No null check before N dereference
Normal guarantees assume returning ABI-conforming callee

contracts.abi: ECX=H, dword query pointer Q at entry ESP+4; RET4; returns EAX=0 for exhausted traversal, EAX=1 after matched-node cleanup returns; EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI preserved

fields.role: Cursor-like pointer, advanced if matched node
Payload comparison pointer, later forwarded to00944c94

contracts.search: Start N=read32(H+2), retain initial head; for each nonzero N reset EDI=Q, ESI=read32(N), ECX=sign_extend32(read16(N+4)); XOR EBP,EBP sets ZF; REPE CMPSB then JE accepts ZF=1, else advance N=read32(N+6)
comparison_edges: Zero length makes no comparison accesses and preserves XOR-set ZF=1, so first such node matches even for Q=0
For nonnegative lengths and DF=0, compares exactly length bytes unless mismatch occurs earlier; no NUL or query-length check, so matching a shorter node prefix is sufficient
Negative signed16 length becomes ECX in0xffff8000..0xffffffff; repeat uses unsigned32 count, can run billions of byte comparisons if memory permits and bytes match
No CLD; inherited DF determines whether ESI/EDI advance or retreat; DS:ESI and ES:EDI are used
ordered_effects_on_match: If N equals initial head, H+2=N.next; otherwise N.prev+6=N.next
If N equals current tail at H+6, H+6=N.prev; otherwise N.next+10=N.prev
If N equals current H+10, H+10=read32(H+10+6)
Call0068d010 with ECX=N, then00944c94(N), then return1
contracts.no_match: Return0 without object-field writes or calls; null head avoids query argument load and payload comparison
contracts.failure_boundary: All unlink/count/cursor writes precede both cleanup calls. No local exception frame, rollback, callee-result test or recoverable error result; interrupted cleanup may leave the node detached and the count decremented
limits: First byte-content match only; not pointer identity or assured whole-string equality
No cycle, extent, negative-length, null-query, link-consistency or alias check
No complete ownership or thread/reentrancy safety
Node fields not cleared before release

contracts.abi: Inherited EBP must point to enclosing frame; no own stack arguments read or consumed; RET; no standalone ordinary C prototype established
contracts.guard: Read32(EBP-0x1c)!=0 returns immediately without calls or pushes; EAX unchanged on this branch
contracts.zero_guard: Push parent-frame dwords in order +0x14,+0x10,+0xc,+8; call0094633b; RET; normal EAX unchanged after that callee and not interpreted
contracts.forwarding: Callee receives parent frame +8,+0xc,+0x10,+0x14 in that argument order, not the helper's own entry-stack arguments
contracts.stack_balance_context: Original PE instruction at00946396 is RET0x10; normal callee return removes the four forwarded dwords
contracts.r17_connection: 009462bb sets parent flag at EBP-0x1c=1 before ordinary call to00946323, so that observed path performs no further cleanup call. While flag0, forwarded base/count are the current mutable frame values rather than guaranteed original inputs
limits: Parent exception handler, actual exceptional reachability and0094633b effects remain boundaries
No complete exceptional cleanup or lifetime guarantee

r17_refinement: 007ae4f0 supplies query P to0068d1f0 on receiver00b74438, ignores its result and then calls00944c94(P). The search uses bytes at P; matching is not proven to be allocation identity, and target-node payload may alias P. No disjointness or double-release safety follows
rng_io: No direct identified RNG or I/O operations; transitive effects remain open
excluded_claims: Complete object lifetime or allocator contract
